item.title: Defense Ministry: “Claims of Minister Ahn’s Desertion Are Clearly False… Will Request Correction of Records After Tenure” (국방부 “安장관 탈영 주장 허위…퇴임후 기록 정정 청구할 것")
item.description:
Defense Ministry: “Claims of Minister Ahn’s Desertion Are Clearly False… Will Request Correction of Records After Tenure” (국방부 “安장관 탈영 주장 허위…퇴임후 기록 정정 청구할 것")

The Ministry of National Defense stated on the 10th regarding suspicions that Minister Ahn Gyu-back had absented himself from his duty post while serving as a reserve soldier that “the (claim of) desertion is clearly false,” and that once the minister’s term ends, he will request a correction of the error in his military service record. (국방부는 안규백 장관이 방위병으로 복무하면서 근무지를 이탈했다는 의혹과 관련해 “탈영 (주장)은 명백한 허위”라며 장관 임기가 끝나면 병적기록 오류에 대해 정정을 청구하겠다고 10일 밝혔다.)

A Defense Ministry official told reporters on the same day, “The claim of desertion is clearly false.” (국방부 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “탈영 (주장은) 명백한 허위”라고 했다.)

The official added, “According to the Sungkyunkwan University academic records disclosed by Rep. Han Ki-ho (during the confirmation hearing), it is clear that (Minister Ahn) enlisted on November 5, 1983, and was discharged on January 4, 1985. If the claim that he deserted and served an additional seven months were true, I would ask how he could have had a university transcript for the first semester of 1985.” (이 관계자는 “(인사청문회 당시) 한기호 의원이 공개한 성균관대 학적부에 따르면 1983년 11월 5일 입대해 1985년 1월 4일 제대 사실이 분명하다”라며 “탈영해서 추가복무를 7개월 했다는 주장이 사실이라면 어떻게 1985년 1학기 대학 성적이 있는지 반문하고 싶다”고 했다.)

It is known that Minister Ahn’s period of service as a reserve soldier is recorded in his military service record as 22 months, not the usual 14 months. During the confirmation hearing in July of last year, the opposition raised suspicions of absence from duty or confinement to the guardhouse. The controversy, which quieted down after the confirmation hearing, flared up again on the 6th when Kim Young-soo, a retired Navy lieutenant commander and head of the ‘Public Interest Reporting Center for a Clean Society,’ held a press conference at the National Assembly to publicly raise the issue. (안 장관의 방위병 복무 기간은 통상적인 14개월이 아닌 22개월로 병적기록부에 기록돼 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 지난해 7월 인사청문회 당시 야당에서는 근무지 이탈 혹은 영창 입소 의혹을 제기했다. 인사청문회 이후 잦아들었던 논란은 지난 6일 예비역 해군 소령인 김영수 ‘청렴사회를 위한 공익신고센터’ 센터장이 국회 기자회견을 열고 공개 문제제기를 하며 다시 불거졌다.)

Lieutenant Commander Kim claims that Minister Ahn, after being called up as a reserve soldier in November 1983 and serving in a company in Daesan-myeon, Gochang County, North Jeolla Province, under the Army’s 35th Infantry Division, illegally absented himself from military duty for about seven months. Kim asserts that Minister Ahn was then detained for 30 days and subsequently served an additional seven months, resulting in a total service period of 22 months. (김 소장은 안 장관이 1983년 11월 방위병으로 소집돼 육군 제35사단 전북 고창군 대산면 중대에서 복무하던 중 약 7개월간 위법적으로 군무를 이탈했다고 주장하고 있다. 김 소장은 안 장관이 30일 구금됐고 이후 7개월을 더 복무하면서 복무기간이 22개월이 됐다는 것이다.)

In contrast, Minister Ahn explained during the confirmation hearing that, concerning an incident where his family provided lunch to active-duty soldiers in the unit during his service, he was investigated by military authorities for about three to four days. He said that in connection with this, after finishing the first semester of 1985, he worked for a ‘few more days’ during the summer break to complete that period. He explained that during this process, the final period of service was recorded as his discharge date, leading to a record showing he served approximately eight months longer than his actual service. (반면 안 장관은 인사청문회에서 복무 중 자신의 집안에서 부대 현역병에게 점심을 제공한 것과 관련해 군 관계기관의 조사를 3~4일 가량 받았고, 이와 관련해 1985년 1학기를 마치고 여름방학 중 해당 기간을 마저 채우기 위해 ‘며칠’ 더 근무했다고 설명했다. 이 과정에서 마지막 복무 시점이 전역일로 잡히면서 8개월 가량 더 복무한 것처럼 기록이 남았다는 것이다.)

The Defense Ministry has drawn a line on calls from some opposition quarters for the ‘disclosure of military service records’ to resolve suspicions. A Defense Ministry official explained, “If we were to disclose a 40-year-old erroneous record, wouldn’t that leave only the incorrect record in people’s minds, regardless of the facts?” adding, “We have not disclosed it because it would only fuel further misunderstanding.” (야권 일각에서 의혹 해소를 위해서는 ‘병적기록을 공개해야 한다’는 주장에 국방부는 선을 그었다. 국방부 관계자는 “40년 전 잘못된 기록을 공개한다면 사실관계와 상관없이 잘못된 기록만이 머리에 남지 않겠나”라며 “오해만 더 키울 것이어서 공개하지 않은 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Minister Ahn Gyu-back claims he first discovered the error in his military service record in 2016. However, he has not corrected the record to this day, nearly ten years later. Regarding the criticism of ‘If he is truly a victim of administrative error, why hasn’t he corrected his military service record?’, a Defense Ministry official stated, “If he were to request a correction while serving as the Minister of National Defense, mightn’t that spark other controversies?” adding, “He plans to request the correction and take additional measures after completing his duties and returning to a status without power.” (안규백 장관은 2016년 처음 병적 기록 오류를 발견했다고 주장하고 있다. 하지만 약 10년이 지난 지금까지도 병적기록을 정정하지 않고 있다. ‘정말 병무행정의 피해자라면 왜 병적 기록을 정정하지 않느냐’라고 지적에 대해 국방부 관계자는 “국방장관 신분으로 정정 청구를 한다면 또 다른 논란이 나올 수 있지 않겠나”라며 “부여된 일을 마치고 권력이 없는 신분으로 돌아갈 때 정정 청구 및 추가 조치를 할 계획”이라고 말했다.)

Within the Defense Ministry, it has been reported that there are concerns that if the incumbent minister requested a correction of his military service record, the opposition could raise issues, claiming that the relevant Defense Ministry departments and the Military Manpower Administration, which handle the practical work, had not processed it fairly. (국방부 내에는 현직 장관 신분으로 병적기록 수정을 요구할 경우 실무를 담당하는 국방부 관련 부서와 병무청이 공정하게 처리하지 않았다며 야권에서 문제제기를 할 수 있다는 우려가 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Minister Ahn, who returned to Korea on the 10th after a business trip to NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization), has not issued any messages regarding the suspicions of absence from military duty or the issue of unifying the service academies. (안 장관은 10일 나토(북대서양조약기구) 출장을 마치고 귀국했지만 군무 이탈 의혹이나 사관학교 통합과 관련한 메시지는 내지 않고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee Appoints Vice Minister of Planning and Budget Lim Ki-geun as New Chief of Office for Government Policy Coordination (李대통령, 신임 국무조정실장에 임기근 기획예산처 차관 임명)
item.description:
President Lee Appoints Vice Minister of Planning and Budget Lim Ki-geun as New Chief of Office for Government Policy Coordination (李대통령, 신임 국무조정실장에 임기근 기획예산처 차관 임명)

President Lee Jae-myung appointed Lim Ki-geun, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Planning and Budget, as the new Chief of the Office for Government Policy Coordination (ministerial level) on the 10th. (이재명 대통령은 10일 신임 국무조정실장(장관급)에 임기근 기획예산처 차관을 임명했다.)

Cheong Wa Dae Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Sung Ki-hong said in a briefing that afternoon, “New Chief Lim is a top expert in economic policy, having served as Director General for Policy Coordination at the Ministry of Economy and Finance, Deputy Minister for Budget Affairs, Commissioner of the Public Procurement Service, and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Planning and Budget.” He added, “Based on his experience in coordinating complex economic policies, we expect him to rationally adjust inter-ministerial interests and stably manage state affairs as the Chief of the Office for Government Policy Coordination.” (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 오후 브리핑에서 “임 신임 실장은 기획재정부 정책조정국장, 예산총괄심의관, 조달청장, 기획예산처 차관 등을 거친 경제정책 분야 최고 전문가”라며 “복잡한 경제정책을 조율해 온 경험을 바탕으로 국무조정실장으로서 부처 간 이해관계를 합리적으로 조정하고, 국정 현안을 안정적으로 관리할 것으로 기대한다”고 했다.)

A native of Haenam, South Jeolla Province, Chief Lim graduated from Seoul National University's Department of Business Administration and, after passing the 36th Higher Civil Service Examination, has worked consistently in the budget sector of the Ministry of Economy and Finance. He served as Second Vice Minister of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, and after the ministry was split into the Ministry of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Planning and Budget, he became Vice Minister of the Ministry of Planning and Budget. (전남 해남 출신인 임 실장은 서울대 경영학과를 나왔고, 36회 행정고시에 합격한 뒤 줄곧 기획재정부 예산 분야에서 일해왔다. 기재부 2차관으로 있다가, 기재부가 재정경제부와 기획예산처로 나뉜 뒤 기획예산처 차관으로 있었다.)

Previously, former Chief of the Office for Government Policy Coordination Yoon Chang-ryul expressed his intention to resign. Regarding the replacement of the chief, Senior Secretary Sung said, “Since the new Prime Minister has been appointed and started work, I understand that the former chief’s opinion that it would be desirable to work in sync with the new chief was respected.” <<>> (앞서 윤창렬 전 국무조정실장은 사의를 표했다. 국무조정실장 교체와 관련해, 성 수석은 “아무래도 새 국무총리가 임명되시고 일을 시작하셨기 때문에 새로운 국무조정실장을 통해서 호흡을 같이 하는 게 바람직하다는 전임 실장님의 의견이 존중된 것으로 알고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Visits Yi Tae-jun Memorial in Ulaanbaatar, Vows to ‘Carry Forward His Noble Spirit into the Korea-Mongolia Golden Age’ (李대통령, 울란바타르 이태준 열사 기념관 참배… “숭고한 뜻 ‘한몽 황금시대’로 이어갈 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Visits Yi Tae-jun Memorial in Ulaanbaatar, Vows to ‘Carry Forward His Noble Spirit into the Korea-Mongolia Golden Age’ (李대통령, 울란바타르 이태준 열사 기념관 참배… “숭고한 뜻 ‘한몽 황금시대’로 이어갈 것”)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, visited the Yi Tae-jun Memorial Park in downtown Ulaanbaatar on the 10th (local time) to honor the noble spirit of sacrifice of Martyr Yi Tae-jun, who contributed to the development of modern medicine in Mongolia and devoted himself to the independence of his homeland. ()

This year marks the 105th anniversary of the martyrdom of Yi Tae-jun. He sought asylum in Mongolia in 1914, opened a hospital called “Donguiuiguk,” and eradicated syphilis, a chronic disease in Mongolia at the time, serving as the royal physician to the Mongolian king. He was also a disciple of Dosan Ahn Chang-ho and a key independence activist who provided substantial financial support to independence movement groups such as the Uiyeoldan (Righteous Brotherhood). (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 10일(현지 시각) 울란바타르 시내에 있는 이태준 기념 공원을 찾아 몽골의 근대 의료 발전에 기여하고 조국의 독립을 위해 헌신한 이태준 열사의 숭고한 희생 정신을 기렸다.)

At 10:05 a.m. that day, President Lee arrived at the memorial park dressed in a dark suit and navy tie, greeted by cheers from local Koreans, including the head of the Korean Association. Standing before the symbolic grave and monument of Martyr Yi, President Lee laid a wreath of white lilies bearing the inscription “105th Anniversary of Martyr Yi Tae-jun’s Death, President of the Republic of Korea Lee Jae-myung,” and bowed his head in silent tribute as a requiem played. (올해로 순국 105주년을 맞이한 이태준 열사는 1914년 몽골로 망명해 병원 ‘동의의국’을 개업하고 당시 몽골의 고질병이었던 화류병을 퇴치해 몽골 국왕의 어의(御醫)로 활동한 인물이다. 동시에 도산 안창호 선생의 제자이자 의열단 등 독립운동 단체에 거액의 재정을 지원한 핵심 독립운동가다.)

Immediately after laying the wreath, President Lee showed deep interest by asking the defense attaché, who was guiding the event, about the exact location of the actual grave. The martyr’s remains are known to have been buried near the Jaiseng hill in the past, but the precise location remains unknown. President Lee carefully examined records left by Lyuh Woon-hyung, who had previously visited the martyr’s tomb, and urged continued efforts to verify historical facts for the complete restoration of this historical legacy. (이날 오전 10시 5분, 짙은색 양복에 네이비 넥타이 차림으로 기념 공원에 도착한 이 대통령은 현지 한인회장 등 동포들의 환호를 받으며 입장했다. 이 대통령은 이태준 선생의 가묘와 기념비 앞에 서서 ‘이태준 선생 순국 제105주년, 대한민국 대통령 이재명’이라고 적힌 흰 백합 화환을 헌화한 뒤, 울려 퍼지는 진혼곡에 맞춰 고개를 숙이고 묵념했다.)

President Lee then moved to the exhibition hall on the second floor of the memorial, where he viewed displays about the martyr’s life and independence movement activities, guided by an Independence Hall interpreter. He examined exhibits including a graduation photo from Severance Medical School, his connection with Ahn Chang-ho, and his special relationship with Kim Kyu-sik. (헌화 직후 이 대통령은 현장 안내를 맡은 국방무관에게 진짜 묘역의 위치를 물으며 깊은 관심을 보였다. 열사의 유해는 과거 자이승 구릉 인근에 묻힌 것으로 알려졌으나 정확한 위치는 미상인 상태다. 이 대통령은 여운형 선생이 과거 열사의 무덤을 참배하고 남긴 기록 등을 꼼꼼히 살피며, 역사적 유산의 완벽한 복원을 위한 지속적인 고증 노력을 당부했다.)

During his viewing of a report in the Independence Newspaper (under the “Geomauiyeon” column) detailing Yi Tae-jun’s financial support to independence movement groups, President Lee remarked, “Publishing the list of people who donated money to the independence movement in the newspaper like this would have leaked information to the Japanese colonial authorities, causing serious problems. I think the names in the reports were likely pseudonyms to avoid information leaks and surveillance.” At an AI-restored video display showing the martyr’s appearance, President Lee paused briefly and exclaimed, “It really looks like him.” (이어 이 대통령은 기념관 2층에 마련된 전시관으로 이동해 독립기념관 해설사의 안내에 따라 열사의 생애와 독립운동 자취를 관람했다. 세브란스 의학원 졸업 사진부터 안창호 선생과의 인연, 김규식 선생과의 특별한 관계 등을 담은 전시물을 둘러봤다.)

After completing the viewing, President Lee descended to the memorial lobby to sign the guestbook. He wrote, “I will carry forward Martyr Yi Tae-jun’s noble spirit into the Korea-Mongolia Golden Age.” (특히 이 대통령은 이태준 열사가 독립운동 단체에 재정을 지원한 내역이 담긴 독립신문 보도(거마의연 코너)를 관람하던 중 “독립운동에 돈을 낸 사람들의 명단을 이렇게 그대로 신문에 써놓으면 일제에 정보가 유출되어 심각한 문제가 생겼을 것”이라며 “보도 내용에 적힌 이름들은 정보 유출과 감시를 피하기 위해 가명을 사용한 것이 아닐까 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 이 대통령은 열사의 생전 모습을 인공지능(AI) 기술로 복원한 영상 전시 코너에서는 잠시 발걸음을 멈추고 “정말 닮았다”고 감탄하기도 했다.)

The ceremony was attended by a large number of key figures from the presidential office and cabinet, including Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kwon Oh-eul, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac, and Ambassador to Mongolia Choi Jin-won. (관람을 마친 이 대통령은 기념관 로비로 내려와 방명록에 서명했다. 이 대통령은 ‘이태준 열사의 숭고한 뜻을 한몽 황금시대로 이어가겠습니다’라는 문구를 남겼다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Pioneering Spirit Resembling the Nomadic Spirit Cultivates 'Mongtan'... If You Rarely See the Ambassador, Tell Me Directly" (李대통령 “유목정신 닮은 개척정신이 ‘몽탄’ 일궈… 대사 안 보이면 내게 바로 말하라”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Pioneering Spirit Resembling the Nomadic Spirit Cultivates 'Mongtan'... If You Rarely See the Ambassador, Tell Me Directly" (李대통령 “유목정신 닮은 개척정신이 ‘몽탄’ 일궈… 대사 안 보이면 내게 바로 말하라”)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, held a luncheon meeting with compatriots at a hotel in downtown Ulaanbaatar on the afternoon of the 10th (local time), encouraging the Mongolian Korean community, which has built a vibrant Korean economic sphere in a harsh environment. At the event, President Lee promised to fully strengthen the support capabilities of local diplomatic missions for compatriots, based on the government-wide 'comprehensive survey of overseas compatriot complaints' being promoted since earlier this year. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 10일 오후(현지 시각) 울란바타르 시내 한 호텔에서 동포 오찬 간담회를 열고, 척박한 환경 속에서 활기찬 한인 경제권을 일궈낸 재몽골 동포 사회를 격려했다. 이 대통령은 이 자리에서 올해 초부터 범정부 차원에서 추진 중인 ‘재외 동포 민원 전수조사’를 바탕으로 현지 공관의 동포 지원 역량을 전면 강화하겠다고 약속했다.)

Under the subtitle 'Compatriots Roaming the World are the Main Actors of Korea's Great Leap Forward,' the luncheon was attended by about 80 Mongolian Korean compatriots, along with senior government officials including Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac, Deputy Prime Minister for Economy Koo Yun-cheol, Deputy Prime Minister for Science and Technology Bae Kyung-hoon, Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kwon Oh-eul, and Overseas Koreans Agency Commissioner Kim Kyeong-hyeop. <<>= President Lee, wearing a black suit with a turquoise tie, entered alongside First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, who donned a violet jeogori (traditional jacket) and a white skirt, receiving a standing ovation from the compatriots. They accepted bouquets from children in hanbok and responded with bright smiles. <<>= In his encouragement speech, President Lee highly praised that, unlike typical inter-state exchanges, the Korea-Mongolia relationship has built a solid foundation through the voluntary dedication of compatriots, preceding government-level cooperation. President Lee noted, "Since diplomatic relations were established in 1990, even before full-scale government cooperation began, countless compatriots came to this land, built schools, shared technology, and founded businesses, fostering trust. As a result, Korean shops and enterprises have clustered in Ulaanbaatar, forming a vibrant economic sphere so much so that it's called 'Mongtan New City' (a blend of Dongtan and Mongolia)." <<>= He particularly highlighted the emotional and cultural 'similar temperaments' as the background for the rapid rapprochement between the people of both nations. President Lee said, "The nomadic spirit of Mongolians, who seek new paths across the vast steppes, and the unique pioneering spirit of Koreans, who take root and create paths anywhere in the world, are links that foster natural mutual understanding. Because of this enterprising spirit that challenges rather than stays put, compatriots have deeply rooted themselves in Mongolian society and served as excellent bridges between the two countries." <<>= He continued, "I will ensure that overseas diplomatic missions become a reliable platform and familiar neighbor that directly listens to your voices and seeks solutions together." President Lee looked at Ambassador Choi Jin-won of the Korean Embassy in Mongolia and joked, "If you find it hard to see the ambassador by your side regularly, just tell me directly." <<>= Earlier, in a welcoming speech, Cho Yoon-kyung, President of the Korean Association in Mongolia, said, "There's a joke among our compatriots that 'if you survive in Mongolia, you can survive anywhere in the world.' Just as the noble spirit of Lee Tae-joon, who served as a doctor and independence activist in Mongolia, forms a great foundation for Korea-Mongolia friendly cooperation, I ask for practical government attention and sustained budget support so that our Korean community can responsibly manage and preserve this legacy for future generations." <<>= Concluding his speech, President Lee expressed, "I will build a safer, more reliable, and prouder Korea so that the efforts and dedication of our compatriots are not in vain," and wished for the everlasting development of the Korean community in Mongolia. After the official address, President Lee and the First Lady completed the schedule with a group photo session with compatriot businesspeople and community representatives. (‘세계를 누비는 동포들이 대한민국 대도약의 주역입니다’라는 부제 아래 열린 이날 간담회에는 조현 외교부 장관, 위성락 국가안보실장, 구윤철 경제부총리, 배경훈 과기부총리, 권오을 국가보훈부 장관, 김경협 재외동포청장 등 정부 고위 관계자들과 재몽골 동포 80여 명이 참석했다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: Police Concealed Jung Yi-han’s Staged Terror Hoax, Interfering in the Election (주진우 “정이한 테러 자작극 숨긴 경찰, 선거 개입”)
item.description:
Joo Jin-woo: Police Concealed Jung Yi-han’s Staged Terror Hoax, Interfering in the Election (주진우 “정이한 테러 자작극 숨긴 경찰, 선거 개입”)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo stated on the 10th regarding Reform Party’s Busan mayoral candidate Jung Yi-han’s “staged terror hoax” that “the police improperly interfered in the Busan mayoral election, and by splitting the conservative vote, they aided (Democratic Party) candidate Jeon Jae-soo’s victory.” He added, “I will file a criminal complaint against the police command chain on charges of abuse of authority, dereliction of duty, and violations of the Public Official Election Act.” (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 10일 개혁신당 정이한 부산시장 후보의 ‘테러 자작극’과 관련해 “경찰이 부산시장 선거에 부당하게 개입한 것이고, 보수표 분열을 통해 (민주당) 전재수 후보의 당선을 도운 것”이라며 “담당 경찰 지휘 라인을 직권남용, 직무 유기, 공직선거법 위반 등 혐의로 형사 고발하겠다”고 했다.)

In a press conference at the National Assembly, Joo said, “It has newly been revealed that the police already summoned and questioned Jung Yi-han in May, obtaining a confession regarding the staged terror hoax charges.” (주 의원은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “지난 5월 경찰이 이미 정이한을 소환 조사해 테러 자작극 혐의에 대한 자백을 받았다는 사실이 새로 밝혀졌다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Joo claimed, “(Candidate Jung) wore a fake neck brace, posed as a terror victim, and split the conservative vote to the very end,” adding, “As a result, (People Power Party) candidate Park Hyung-joon lost the election.” He continued, “It is shocking that although Jung Yi-han showed up at the police station and confessed to the staged terror hoax, the police kept it hidden until after the election.” He further argued, “The police watched the crime scene in real time and actively aided Jung Yi-han’s election crimes.” (주 의원은 “(정 후보는) 가짜 목깁스를 하고, 테러 피해자를 자처하며 보수표를 끝까지 갈라친 것”이라며 “그로 인해 (국민의힘) 박형준 후보가 낙선한 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “정 후보가 경찰에 출석해 테러 자작극 혐의를 자백했는데도, 경찰이 선거가 끝날 때까지 숨겼다는 사실이 너무나 경악스럽다”며 “경찰이 범죄 현장을 실시간으로 지켜보며 정이한의 선거 범죄를 적극 도운 것”이라고 했다.)

Joo stated, “I believe the police actively assisted Jung Yi-han after he confessed to the staged terror hoax, allowing him to continue his act and commit additional crimes.” He added, “The confession about the staged terror hoax would have already been reported to the Blue House through the National Police Agency in May,” and asked, “We need to know how far up it was reported and why the police condoned the additional crime of letting him complete the campaign without informing the media.” (주 의원은 “정이한이 테러 자작극 범죄를 자백하고도 계속 쇼를 하며 추가 범죄를 하는데 경찰이 적극 조력했다고 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 “테러 자작극 자백은 5월에 이미 경찰청을 통해 청와대에 보고됐을 것”이라며 “어디까지 보고됐고, 언론에 알리지 않고 완주하는 추가 범죄를 왜 방조했는지 밝혀야 한다”고 했다.)

After the press conference, Joo told reporters, “I cannot trust the police, but due to loopholes in the current investigation system, I will file a complaint with the police. If the investigation does not proceed properly, I will strongly demand an investigation through a special counsel.” (주 의원은 회견 후 기자들과 만나 “경찰을 믿을 수 없지만 현재 수사 체계의 허점 때문에 (경찰에) 고소하고, 수사가 제대로 진행되지 않는다면 특검을 통해 수사할 것을 강력히 요구하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Reform Party, Joo also said, “They must disclose when they became aware of this fact and take appropriate responsibility.” He noted, “I understand that Reform Party officials also went to support (the Busan mayoral campaign). While the candidate was being questioned by the police, election activities would have stopped—how could the campaign not have known?” He added, “I believe the facts must be clarified until the public is fully convinced.” (주 의원은 개혁신당과 관련해서도 “이 사실을 언제 인지했는지 밝혀 그에 합당한 책임을 져야 할 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “개혁신당 관계자들도 (부산시장 캠프에) 지원을 갔던 것으로 알고 있다. 후보자가 경찰 소환 조사를 받는 동안 선거운동이 중단됐을 텐데, 캠프에서 이를 몰랐겠느냐”며 “국민이 확실히 납득할 수 있을 때까지 사실관계가 규명돼야 한다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government Pursues Abolition of Mandatory Reporting for Contacts with Chosen Soren Figures (정부, 조총련 인사 접촉시 신고 의무 폐지 추진)
item.description:
Government Pursues Abolition of Mandatory Reporting for Contacts with Chosen Soren Figures (정부, 조총련 인사 접촉시 신고 의무 폐지 추진)

The government is pushing forward with a plan to abolish the mandatory reporting requirement when South Korean citizens come into contact with members of the pro-Pyongyang General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chosen Soren). (정부가 우리 국민이 재일본조선인총연합회(조총련) 인사와 접촉할 때 신고의무를 폐지하는 방안을 추진한다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification on the 10th, the ministry plans to cooperate with the National Assembly to ensure that a revision to the "Act on Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation" (Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act), which deletes the clause treating Chosen Soren as North Korean residents, can be discussed during this year's regular parliamentary session. (10일 통일부에 따르면 통일부는 조총련을 북한 주민으로 간주하는 조항을 삭제한 ‘남북교류협력에 관한 법률’ (남북교류협력법) 개정안이 올해 정기국회에서 논의될 수 있도록 국회와 협력할 계획이다.)

Article 30 of the current Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act stipulates that "members of overseas organizations that act in accordance with North Korea's line are deemed to be residents of North Korea." Founded in 1955, Chosen Soren serves as an external organization of North Korea's Workers' Party, acting as a North Korean representative office in Japan. Legally, Chosen Soren is considered an anti-state organization. Under the current Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act, anyone wishing to contact Chosen Soren figures must report their contact plan to the government in advance, and if contact occurs unexpectedly, they must report it afterward. (현행 남북교류협력법 제30조는 “북한의 노선에 따라 활동하는 국외단체의 구성원은 북한의 주민으로 본다”고 규정하고 있다. 1955년 창설된 조총련은 북한 노동당의 외곽 조직으로 일본에서 북한대표부 역할을 한다. 조총련은 법적으로는 반국가단체에 해당한다. 현행 남북교류협력법은 조총련 인사와 접촉하려면 정부에 사전에 대북 접촉계획을 신고해야 하고 예상치 못하게 접촉하게 된 경우에는 사후에 신고하도록 되어 있다.)

The government explains that this move reflects changing realities, including the fact that Chosen Soren's size and influence have diminished compared to the past, and that a significant number of its members hold South Korean nationality. Recently, Chosen Soren revised its charter, deleting phrases such as "achieving independent peaceful reunification" and "respecting the June 15 Joint Declaration." Provisions from the previous charter that called for strengthening ties among South, North, and overseas compatriots, including a federation-style unification, were also removed during the revision, and the policy of solidarity and cooperation with the Korean Residents' Union in Japan (Mindan), a pro-Seoul Korean residents' organization, was abandoned. <<> Under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the Ministry of Unification had imposed fines on a civic group led by actor Kwon Hae-hyo (Montang Yeonpil, or "People Together with Joseon Schools") for engaging in "unauthorized contact" without reporting amid its support projects for pro-Pyongyang schools. Director Kim Ji-woon, who produced a documentary on discrimination against ethnic Koreans in Japan, was also investigated on the same charges and received a warning. (정부는 조총련의 규모와 영향력이 과거에 비해 감소했고 조총련 구성원 중에는 대한민국 국적자도 상당하다는 점 등 변화한 현실을 반영하겠다는 설명이다. 최근 조총련은 단체 강령에서 ‘자주적 평화통일 성취’나 ‘6·15 공동선언 존중’ 등의 문구를 삭제하는 등 강령을 개정했다. 과거 강령에 명시됐던 연방제 방식의 통일을 비롯한 남·북·해외 동포 간 유대 강화 조항도 개정 과정에서 모두 사라졌고 재일 한국인 단체인 재일본대한민국민단(민단)과의 연대·협력 방침도 폐기됐다.)

item.title: Chae Yi-bae, Former Democratic Party Emergency Committee Member, Appointed as Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Han Duck-soo (한성숙 총리 비서실장에 채이배 전 민주당 비대위원)
item.description:
Chae Yi-bae, Former Democratic Party Emergency Committee Member, Appointed as Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Han Duck-soo (한성숙 총리 비서실장에 채이배 전 민주당 비대위원)

On the 10th, former lawmaker Chae Yi-bae, who served on the Democratic Party of Korea's emergency committee, was appointed as the Chief of Staff to the Prime Minister (vice-ministerial level), supporting Prime Minister Han Duck-soo. (한성숙 국무총리를 보좌하는 국무총리비서실장(차관급)에 10일 더불어민주당 비상대책위원을 지낸 채이배 전 국회의원이 임명됐다.)

The Prime Minister's Office distributed a press release that afternoon, announcing that Chae would begin his term as the new Chief of Staff to the Prime Minister on the 11th. (총리실은 이날 오후 보도 자료를 배포해 채 의원이 11일 신임 총리비서실장으로 임기를 시작한다고 밝혔다.)

Born in 1975 in Gunsan, North Jeolla Province, Chief Chae graduated from Incheon Gyeyang High School and earned a degree in Public Administration from Korea University. He also completed a master's program in Commercial Law at Korea University's Graduate School of Law. Working as a certified public accountant, he served as a secretary for the Economic Democratization Committee at the People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy, a research fellow at the Institute for Good Corporate Governance, and a research fellow at the Institute for Economic Reform. In 2016, he was elected as a proportional representative for the People's Party and served as a member of the 20th National Assembly. During his tenure as a lawmaker, he served as the chairman of the Policy Committee of the Bareunmirae Party, formed after the merger of the People's Party and the Bareun Party. (1975년 전북 군산에서 태어난 채 실장은 인천 계산고와 고려대 행정학과를 졸업했고, 고려대 법학대학원에서 상법 전공으로 석사과정을 수료했다. 공인회계사로 활동하면서 참여연대 경제민주화위원회 간사, 좋은기업지배연구소 연구위원, 경제개혁연구소 연구위원을 지냈다. 2016년 국민의당 비례대표로 당선돼 20대 국회의원을 지냈다. 의원 재임 중에는 국민의당과 바른정당이 바른미래당으로 합당하면서 바른미래당 정책위원회 의장을 지냈다.)

After his term as a lawmaker ended, he left the Minsaeng Party, the successor of the Bareunmirae Party, and joined the Democratic Party after being recruited by President Lee Jae-myung, then the party leader. He served as a special advisor for fair economy under Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum during the Moon Jae-in administration. During the 20th presidential election in 2022, when President Lee competed against former President Yoon Suk Yeol, he served as the chairman of the Fair Market Committee under the election campaign committee, and later as a member of the Democratic Party's emergency committee formed after President Lee's defeat in the election. (의원 임기 종료 후에는 바른미래당의 후신인 민생당을 탈당했고, 민주당 대표였던 이재명 대통령의 영입으로 민주당에 입당했다. 문재인 정부 김부겸 총리의 공정경제특별보좌관을 지냈다. 이 대통령이 윤석열 전 대통령과 경쟁한 2022년 20대 대선에서는 선거대책위원회 공정시장위원장, 이 대통령의 대선 패배 이후 구성된 민주당 비상대책위원회에서 위원을 지냈다.)

Chief Chae is known to have first met Prime Minister Han, then the CEO of Naver, while serving on the National Assembly's Political Affairs Committee during his time as a lawmaker. (채 실장은 의원 시절 국회 정무위원회에서 활동하면서 당시 네이버 대표였던 한 총리와 처음 만난 것으로 알려졌다.)

The Prime Minister's Office evaluated the new Chief Chae as "an economic expert with political acumen who has worked to alleviate polarization by fostering a fair competitive environment and promoting sustainable economic growth." (총리실은 신임 채 실장에 대해 “공정한 경쟁 환경을 조성하고 지속 가능한 경제 성장을 통해 양극화 완화를 위해 노력해 온 정무적 감각을 겸비한 경제 전문가”라고 평가했다.)

It added, "Based on this experience and expertise, Chief Chae is expected to support Prime Minister Han, who has emphasized growth for all citizens, in areas such as recovering the people's livelihood economy and facilitating major transitions like AX (AI transformation) and GX (green transformation), thereby contributing to achieving tangible national policy outcomes that the public can feel." (이어 “채 실장은 이러한 경력과 전문성을 바탕으로, 국민 모두의 성장을 강조해 온 한 총리를 보좌해 민생 경제 회복, AX(인공지능 전환)·GX(녹색 전환) 대전환 등을 지원해 국민께서 체감할 수 있는 국정 성과를 도출하는 데 기여할 것으로 기대된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Rep. Jang Blocked Again at National Police Agency Entrance... Meeting with Acting Police Chief Falls Through (경찰청 입구에서 또 제지당한 張... 경찰청장 직대 면담도 불발)
item.description:
Rep. Jang Blocked Again at National Police Agency Entrance... Meeting with Acting Police Chief Falls Through (경찰청 입구에서 또 제지당한 張... 경찰청장 직대 면담도 불발)

People Power Party (PPP) Representative Jang Dong-hyuk visited the National Police Agency to protest allegations of poor investigation and cover-up by police regarding the "Murder of a High School Girl in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province," but was blocked at the entrance, following a similar incident at the Gwangju Police Agency. The police, who had prevented entry the previous day citing the absence of the commissioner, stated this time, "In accordance with the building's security regulations, media coverage is not permitted." After about 50 minutes of standoff, the meeting between the PPP leadership and the acting National Police Agency commissioner fell through. <<> Rep. Jang was scheduled to meet with Acting Commissioner Yoo Jae-sung at the National Police Agency in Migeun-dong, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, at 4:00 PM that day. However, he was blocked in the agency's lobby and unable to proceed to the office. <<> A police official explained, "We are fully willing to hold meetings with lawmakers and plan to humbly listen to any criticisms they raise," but added, "According to the building's access and security regulations, journalists and aides cannot enter." At the scene, Rep. Jang was accompanied by Supreme Council Member Shin Dong-wook, Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong, Chief of the Party Leader's Office Park Jun-tae, and lawmakers Jo Bae-sook, Joo Jin-woo, and Park Seong-hoon. <<> All PPP lawmakers requested that at least their opening remarks be made available to the press. Rep. item.title: President Lee Presents Traditional Korean Bow Set to Mongolian President (李대통령, 몽골 대통령에 국궁세트 선물)
item.description:
President Lee Presents Traditional Korean Bow Set to Mongolian President (李대통령, 몽골 대통령에 국궁세트 선물)

The presidential office announced on the 10th that President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Mongolia, presented a set of traditional Korean bows and a smartwatch to Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 10일 오흐나 후렐수흐 몽골 대통령에게 국궁 세트와 스마트 워치를 선물했다고 청와대가 밝혔다.)

The traditional bow set was crafted using traditional methods by bonding water buffalo horn and bamboo. Archery is not only one of the three main events of the Naadam Festival, Mongolia's largest holiday, but also a traditional culture shared by both Korea and Mongolia, so the bow set was chosen as a gift for President Khürelsükh. President Lee also delivered a smartwatch equipped with the latest features, tailored to President Khürelsükh's taste, who enjoys exercise in his daily life. (국궁 세트는 물소뿔, 대나무를 접합해 전통 기법으로 제작했다. 활쏘기는 몽골 최대 명절인 나담 축제의 3대 종목 중 하나일 뿐만 아니라 한-몽골 양국이 공유하는 전통 문화라는 점에서 국궁 세트를 후렐수흐 대통령에 대한 선물로 정해졌다. 이 대통령은 평소 운동을 즐기는 후렐수흐 대통령의 취향에 맞춰 최신 기능이 탑재된 스마트 워치도 전달했다.)

In addition, First Lady Berlerchechek was presented with a butterfly and vine-patterned mother-of-pearl lacquerware box in a jade color reminiscent of Mongolia's vast grasslands and abundant nature. The mother-of-pearl box is decorated with butterfly and vine patterns. The presidential office explained that the butterfly, symbolizing happiness and prosperity, and the endlessly sprawling vine represent prosperity and longevity. (아울러 벌러르체첵 여사에게는 몽골의 광활한 초원과 풍요로운 자연이 연상되는 비취색을 사용한 나비당초 나전함을 선물했다. 나전함은 나비와 당초(덩굴) 문양으로 장식됐다. 행복과 번영을 상징하는 나비와 끝없이 뻗어나가는 덩굴은 번영과 장수를 의미한다고 청와대는 설명했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee attended a state banquet hosted by President Khürelsükh on the same day. The banquet was attended by business figures such as LS Group Chairman Koo Ja-eun, SK Vice Chairman Lee Hyung-hee, GS Retail CEO Heo Seo-hong, and Emart CEO Han Chae-yang, along with heads of institutions including KOTRA President Kang Kyung-sung and Korea Eximbank President Hwang Ki-yeon. (한편 이 대통령은 이날 후렐수흐 대통령 주최 국빈만찬에 참석한다. 만찬에는 구자은 LS 회장, 이형희 SK 부회장, 허서홍 GS리테일 대표, 한채양 이마트 대표 등 기업인과 강경성 대한무역투자진흥공사(KOTRA) 사장, 황기연 한국수출입은행장 등 기관장이 참석한다.)

The banquet menu featured smoked salmon and beef tongue appetizers, tomato and bell pepper cream soup, halibut fillet, and braised beef brisket. (만찬 메뉴로는 훈제 연어와 우설 전채, 토마토와 피망 크림수프, 할리벗 필레, 소뽈살 찜이 제공된다.)

item.title: "Public Livelihood Cases Require Supplementary Investigation": Ruling Party Also Pushes for Legislation Internally (“민생 사건은 보완수사 필요” 與 내부서도 법안 발의 나서)
item.description:
On the 10th, the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, opened the first subcommittee on legislative review to examine amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act aimed at abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. The Democratic Party proposed the amendment the previous day and plans to process it before the party's national convention on August 17. Rep. Seo Young-kyo, a Democratic Party member and chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, met with reporters before the review and stated, "We will proceed with speed, aligning with the launch of the Public Prosecution Office and the Major Crimes Investigation Office on October 2, while ensuring the content is fleshed out." <<> However, on the same day, arguments for retaining the supplementary investigation authority were raised within the legal community and the Democratic Party itself. Rep. Hong Ki-won (Pyeongtaek Gap, Gyeonggi) of the Democratic Party told this publication, "We have prepared a draft amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that includes partial retention of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority." The bill recognizes the supplementary investigation authority in five cases: events involving socially vulnerable groups such as children, the elderly, and the disabled; urgent public livelihood-related cases; cases where detention periods or statutes of limitation are imminent; cases requiring merged investigations; and cases where victims demand supplementary investigations by prosecutors. It is scheduled to be proposed as early as the 13th. <<> The Korean Bar Association issued a statement on the same day, saying, "The scope of direct supplementary investigations by prosecutors should be rationally designed," and adding, "It is necessary to recognize it only for public livelihood cases directly related to the lives of the majority of citizens." Previously, the Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun) also announced results from an online survey of 403 members, showing that 67% believed the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority should be maintained (including partial retention). <<> The discussion on abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority has been driven by strong supporters of the Democratic Party and led by hardliners within the party. President Lee Jae-myung has mentioned the need for the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority under exceptional circumstances, and experts, including those from the advisory committee of the prosecution reform task force under the Prime Minister's Office, have also argued for its retention. Nevertheless, amid demands from the ruling party's support base, the government confirmed the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority last month and delegated the discussion to the Democratic Party. (국회 법제사법위원회는 10일 더불어민주당 주도로 법안심사1소위를 열어 검찰의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안 심사에 착수했다. 민주당은 전날 형소법 개정안을 발의했고, 8·17 민주당 전당대회 전에 처리할 방침이다. 민주당 소속인 서영교 법사위원장은 형소법 심사에 앞서 기자들과 만나 “10월 2일에 공소청과 중대범죄수사청이 출범하는 데 맞춰 속도감 있게 하되 내용은 채워가면서 (심사) 하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: "No Unification"... Pro-Lee Faction Shows Signs of Splitting into Pro-Seok and Pro-Song Camps (“단일화 없다”… 친명, 친석·친송으로 분화 조짐)
item.description:
Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17th national convention, signs of fragmentation within the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction are emerging. The pro-Lee faction, which maintained a united front against the pro-Chung Sye-kyun faction, is now splitting into pro-Kim Min-seok and pro-Song Young-gil camps as former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil have entered the party leadership race, competing for "Lee's favor." With the addition of pro-Moon Jae-in lawmaker Ko Min-jung joining the race, the competition for party power among factions is expected to intensify. <<> Lawmaker Song Young-gil said during a meeting with party members in Seo-gu, Gwangju on the 10th, "There will be no withdrawal or unification," adding, "I will finish the race to win. I'll go all the way." He also stated, "The idea that I am a pacemaker for former Prime Minister Kim is just politicians' thinking. Song Young-gil is not a pacemaker but a sure-win maker." <<> Song's camp has been making consecutive statements about "finishing the convention race" since the party's convention preparation committee decided on the 7th to use a preferential voting system instead of a runoff vote for the party leadership election. Preferential voting allows each voter to rank all candidates in order of preference. A figure from Song's camp said, "With the preferential voting system, party members can vote for Song without worrying about wasting their votes." <<> Lawmaker Min Byung-deok from Song's camp also said in a radio interview on the same day, "The core of Song's winning card is that he is 'someone who has done it before' as party leader," adding, "Former Prime Minister Kim, on the other hand, lacks experience in independently running the party. That's a bit regrettable." A Democratic Party official said, "Initially, it was thought that former Prime Minister Kim and Song would continue to align, but recently, as the two candidates engage in a battle for distinctiveness, there are also many predictions that each will finish the race." <<> When asked if former Prime Minister Kim is not the representative candidate of the pro-Lee faction, Min said, "Isn't it true that candidate Song met with the president the day after his overseas trip and had extensive discussions?" Song had a private dinner with President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th of last month at the presidential residence in Hannam-dong, Seoul, right after Lee returned from a European tour. Min noted, "Media reports said that at the dinner, the president said, 'There's no rule that says you (Song) can't do it' and 'If you come in first, you (Song) will take the party leadership'... It was a signal to party members that the president is sending out two national representatives and would be happy if either one succeeds." <<> Lawmaker Park Jie-won, who is supporting Song, also said in a radio interview on the 24th of last month, "The president responded positively to Song's decision to run in the convention, telling him to do well," adding, "The president's remarks made me think, 'Song might indeed become the party leader.'" <<> Meanwhile, former Prime Minister Kim and Song are making consecutive visits to the Honam region, considered the biggest battleground in this convention. For the first time in this convention, the "one delegate, one voting party member, one vote" system is being applied, meaning the Honam vote is expected to play a decisive role. Kim has visited the Honam region five times this month up to the 10th, while Song has visited three times. <<> However, as former Prime Minister Kim and former representative Chung Cheong-rae compete for first and second place in recent opinion polls, there is still an atmosphere among pro-Lee supporters expecting cooperation, believing that unification with Song is essential for Kim's certain victory. Lawmaker Park Sun-won, who is close to Song, said at a press conference the day before announcing his candidacy for the supreme council, "If we do cooperate, we will align with candidate Kim, who has overseen the entire state administration alongside the president, and candidate Song Young-gil, who as a six-term lawmaker knows Honam politics better than anyone." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 당내 친명(親明)계 분화 조짐이 감지되고 있다. 친청계에 맞서 단일대오를 유지하던 친명계가 김민석 전 총리, 송영길 의원이 당대표 선거에 출마한 이후로 친김민석계와 친송영길계로 나뉘어 ‘명심 경쟁’을 펼치는 양상이다. 여기에 친문계 고민정 의원까지 출마하면서 계파 간 당권 경쟁이 더 치열해질 것이란 관측이다.)

item.title: Pro-Myung and Pro-Chung Clash Publicly Over Convention Rules… Late-Night Supreme Council Meeting Also Canceled 40 Minutes Prior (친명·친청, 전대룰 공개 충돌… 심야 최고위도 40분 전 취소)
item.description:
On the 10th, factions supporting Lee Jae-myung (pro-Myung) and those supporting Chung Chung-rae (pro-Chung) clashed head-on over whether to apply a preferential voting system for the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17th national convention to elect the next party leader. After failing to reach a conclusion at the morning Supreme Council meeting, the Democratic Party attempted to reconvene the council at 9 PM to decide, but called it off about 40 minutes beforehand. Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do stated, “It seems we need to put in more effort (to coordinate), so we won’t hold it today,” and indicated that discussions would resume over the weekend. (더불어민주당 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회에 선호투표제를 적용할지를 놓고 10일에도 친명(친이재명)계와 친청(친정청래)계가 정면 충돌했다. 이날 오전 최고위원회의에서 결론을 내지 못한 민주당은 결정을 위해 밤 9시에 다시 최고위를 열려다가 약 40분 전 취소했다. 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 “(조율) 노력을 좀 더 해봐야 할 것 같아 오늘은 못 연다”며 주말에 다시 논의하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The preferential voting system is a method where voters rank all candidates. If no candidate receives a majority, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and votes for that candidate as first preference are reallocated to their second-choice candidate, continuing this process. On the 7th, the party’s convention preparation committee decided to hold the party leadership election using this system. Final confirmation requires approval from the Supreme Council. The pro-Chung faction believes that with a high number of pro-Myung candidates, the preferential voting system puts former lawmaker Chung Chung-rae at a disadvantage. This led to public sparring between both sides at the morning Supreme Council meeting. (선호투표제는 유권자가 모든 후보에 대해 순위를 정해 투표한 뒤, 과반 득표자가 없으면 최하위 후보를 탈락시키고 그 후보를 1순위로 뽑은 유권자 표를 2순위 후보에게 합산하는 것을 반복하는 방식이다. 민주당 전당대회준비위원회는 지난 7일 당대표 선거를 선호투표제로 치르기로 결정했다. 최종 확정을 위해서는 최고위 의결을 거쳐야 한다. 친청계는 친명계 후보 숫자가 많은 상황에서 선호투표제를 실시하면 정청래 전 대표가 불리하다고 보고 있다. 이 때문에 이날 오전 최고위에서 양측이 공개 설전을 벌였다.)

Pro-Myung Supreme Council member Hwang Myung-sun said, “Everyone agreed a year ago, and then-leader Lee Jae-myung introduced this system after deep consideration. Now, they’re trying to shake it just because it’s disadvantageous to a specific candidate.” This referred to the party’s management committee decision in July last year to use preferential voting if there were three or more candidates for the party leadership election. At that time, with only two candidates—Chung Chung-rae and Park Chan-dae—the system was not applied. (친명계인 황명선 최고위원은 “1년 전 모두가 찬성했고 이재명 당시 대표가 고심 끝에 도입한 제도를 이제 와서 특정 후보에게 불리하다는 이유로 흔들고 있다”고 했다. 민주당 당무위가 지난해 7월 당대표 선거를 앞두고 후보가 3인 이상인 경우 선호투표제를 하기로 했던 사실을 거론한 것이다. 당시엔 정청래·박찬대 후보 2인 대결이라 선호투표제가 적용되지 않았다.)

In response, pro-Chung Supreme Council member Lee Sung-yoon argued, “(The preferential voting system) is clearly a violation of the party constitution and rules.” He noted that the party constitution states that a runoff election can be held to elect the party leader, and preferential voting is a different method from a runoff. Supreme Council member Park Kyu-hwan also said, “The behavior of undermining the party constitution for private gain must come to an end.” (그러자 친청계 이성윤 최고위원은 “(선호투표제는) 명백하게 당헌·당규 위반”이라고 했다. 민주당 당헌은 ‘당대표 선출을 위해 결선투표 등을 실시할 수 있다’고 돼 있는데, 선호투표는 결선투표와 다른 별개의 투표 방식이라는 것이다. 박규환 최고위원도 “음험하게 당헌을 훼손하면서까지 사사로운 이익을 도모하는 행태는 사라져야 한다”고 했다.)

Pro-Myung leadership contender and former lawmaker Kim Min-seok said at a meeting with reporters from the Jeonbuk provincial government press corps, “(If a player) keeps quibbling over the rules like this, it looks pretty cheap.” Lawmaker Song Young-gil also stated in a Gwangju KBS interview, “The preferential voting system should naturally be interpreted as a type of runoff election.” In contrast, former lawmaker Chung Chung-rae said, “Last year’s management committee decision is in the past,” and added, “It seems hard to avoid the controversy over violating the party constitution and rules.” (친명계 당권 주자인 김민석 전 총리는 이날 전북도청 출입기자단 간담회에서 “(선수가) 룰에 대해서 시비를 많이 걸면 좀 치사해진다”고 했다. 송영길 의원도 광주KBS 인터뷰에서 “(선호투표제는) 당연히 결선투표의 일종으로 해석해야 한다”고 했다. 반면 정청래 전 대표는 “작년 당무위 결정은 작년 일”이라며 “당헌·당규 위반이라는 논란에서 비켜가기는 어려울 것 같다”고 했다.)

Regarding the introduction of a youth Supreme Council member system, the pro-Myung faction proposed having an elected youth Supreme Council member, while the pro-Chung faction advocated for a system where the party leader would appoint the member. Currently, all candidates who have declared their candidacy for youth Supreme Council member are critical of former lawmaker Chung. (청년 최고위원제 도입을 두고도 친명계는 선출직 청년 최고위원을 두자고 한 반면, 친청계는 당대표가 지명하는 방식으로 운영하자고 맞서고 있다. 현재 청년 최고위원 출마를 선언한 후보들은 모두 정 전 대표에 비판적이다.)

item.title: Whose Hand to Hold… Former Pro-Yoon Faction Meets Oh, Han, and Seok in Turn (누구 손 잡을까… 오·한·석 잇따라 만나는 옛 친윤계)
item.description:
The ruling People Power Party’s mainstream, the former pro-Yoon faction, is expanding its contacts with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, and Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok. The faction, having lost its central axis, appears to be regrouping around centrist figures who supported the impeachment of former President Yoon. Political circles analyze that “ahead of the 2028 general election, calculations among old-guard lawmakers over opposition leadership are becoming increasingly complex.” (국민의힘 주류인 옛 친윤계가 오세훈 서울시장, 무소속 한동훈 의원, 개혁신당 이준석 대표와 접촉면을 확대하고 있다. 구심점을 잃은 옛 친윤계가 중도 지향적이고 윤 전 대통령 탄핵에 찬성했던 인사들 주변으로 헤쳐 모이는 양상이다. 정치권에선 “2028년 총선을 앞두고 야권 주도권을 둘러싼 구(舊)주류 의원들의 셈법이 복잡해지고 있다”는 분석이 나온다.)

Among the individuals former pro-Yoon figures are most frequently meeting after the local elections is Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon. Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik held a private dinner with Mayor Oh on the 9th to discuss internal and external party issues. The two are said to have exchanged views not only on public sentiment confirmed by the recent elections but also on sensitive party matters such as negotiations over forming a parliamentary group, disciplinary actions, and the fate of the current leadership. A party official said, “Isn’t Mayor Oh the most important figure in the party right now? This was a meeting where the floor leader, on behalf of lawmakers, listened to his opinions.” (옛 친윤계 인사들이 지방선거 이후 가장 많이 찾는 사람은 오세훈 서울시장이다. 정점식 원내대표는 지난 9일 오 시장과 비공개 만찬 회동을 갖고 당 안팎의 현안을 논의했다. 두 사람은 이번 선거로 확인된 민심뿐만 아니라 원(院) 구성 협상, 징계, 현 지도부 거취와 같은 민감한 당내 사안에 대해서도 의견을 교환했다고 한다. 당 관계자는 “지금 오 시장은 당에서 가장 중요한 인사 아니냐”며 “원내대표가 의원들을 대신해서 그런 오 시장의 의견을 경청하는 자리였다”고 전했다.)

On the 24th of last month, over 30 People Power Party lawmakers attended Mayor Oh’s lecture at the National Assembly. At the event, in front of Floor Leader Jeong, Mayor Oh remarked, “Do we really need a party leader? We should move toward being a parliamentary-centered party.” Mayor Oh is also reported to have recently met sequentially with lawmakers Kwon Young-se, Na Kyung-won, and Ahn Cheol-soo. (지난달 24일 오 시장의 국회 강연에는 국민의힘 의원 30여 명이 대거 참석하기도 했다. 이 자리에서 오 시장은 정 원내대표 앞에서 “굳이 당대표가 필요한가, 원내 중심 정당으로 가야 한다”고 했다. 오 시장은 최근 권영세·나경원·안철수 의원 등과도 잇따라 만난 것으로 전해졌다.)

Among the 110 People Power Party lawmakers, the old guard, including the former pro-Yoon faction, is estimated to number around 60. Although the central figure of former President Yoon is gone, they are analyzed to still wield influence within the party. The former pro-Yoon faction is said to have contributed to some extent to Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk’s election as party leader at last year’s national convention. However, following the launch of Jang Dong-hyuk’s leadership, a series of controversies erupted, leading many to assess that the faction has shifted to a wait-and-see stance. A People Power Party official said, “With Chairman Jang facing calls to step down after the local election defeat, the loosened former pro-Yoon faction is barely holding together.” (국민의힘 의원 110명 가운데 옛 친윤계를 포함한 구주류는 60명 안팎으로 분류된다. 윤석열 전 대통령이라는 중심축은 사라졌지만, 이들은 여전히 당내에서 영향력을 행사하고 있다는 분석이다. 옛 친윤계는 지난해 전당대회에서 장동혁 대표의 당선에도 일정 부분 기여했다. 하지만 장동혁 지도부 출범 이후 여러 논란이 잇따르자 관망세로 돌아섰다는 평가가 많다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “지방선거 패배로 장 대표가 사퇴론에 직면하면서, 결속력이 약화된 옛 친윤계도 느슨한 형태로 유지되고 있다”고 말했다.)

Among pro-Yoon lawmakers, not a few are paying attention to independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon. Currently, within the pro-Yoon faction, opinions are divided over Han’s potential return to the party, with arguments for both “impossible” and “inevitable.” A former pro-Yoon lawmaker advocating for the “inevitability of return” said, “In this by-election for Busan’s North Gap district, Rep. Han’s vote share was nearly three times that of the People Power Party candidate. If we go against such public sentiment, voters will judge us in the upcoming general election.” Rep. Han himself is also said to be narrowing the psychological distance by proactively reaching out to former pro-Yoon lawmakers, saying, “Senior, please buy me a meal.” Inside and outside the party, Han’s consecutive joining of research groups led by former pro-Yoon heavyweights Kim Gi-hyeon and Yoon Jae-ok is interpreted as “a strategic move with an eye on rejoining the party.” (친윤계 의원 가운데에서는 무소속 한동훈 의원을 주목하는 사람도 적지 않다. 현재 친윤계는 무소속 한동훈 의원의 복당(復黨)을 두고 “불가하다” 또는 “불가피하다”는 양론(兩論)으로 갈려 있는 상태다. ‘복당 불가피론’을 주장하는 옛 친윤계 의원은 “이번 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서 한 의원 득표율이 국민의힘 후보의 세 배에 가깝다”며 “이런 민심에 우리가 역행한다면, 다가오는 총선에서 유권자들이 심판할 것”이라고 말했다. 한 의원 또한 최근 옛 친윤계 의원들에게 “선배님, 밥 사주세요”라고 먼저 연락하며 심리적 거리를 좁히고 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 당 안팎에선 한 의원이 옛 친윤계 중진인 김기현·윤재옥 의원이 회장을 맡은 국회 연구 모임에 연이어 가입한 것을 두고 “복당을 염두에 둔 포석”이라는 해석도 나온다.)

Conversely, there are also many who argue for the “impossibility of Han Dong-hoon.” A People Power Party lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, “Many old-guard figures worry that if Rep. Han returns to the party and seizes control, including over nominations, their own political influence will shrink.” These individuals generally view Mayor Oh as a counterweight to Rep. Han, and some are reportedly also placing hopes on the role of Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok. (반대로 ‘한동훈 불가론’을 주장하는 사람도 적지 않다. 국민의힘 수도권 의원은 “한 의원이 국민의힘으로 복당해서 공천권까지 포함해 당 주도권을 거머쥔다면 자신들의 정치적 입지가 좁아질 것이라고 우려하는 구주류 인사가 적지 않다”고 했다. 이들은 대체로 오 시장을 한 의원의 대항마로 인식하고 있는데, 일부는 개혁신당 이준석 대표의 역할에도 기대를 걸고 있다고 한다.)

Since Mayor Oh is tied to Seoul city administration, limiting his direct involvement in “Yeouido politics,” there is a perspective that Rep. Lee could emerge as a variable in future opposition realignment. In fact, a key former pro-Yoon figure is said to have met privately with Rep. Lee just days before the local elections, persuading him to “return to the People Power Party after the elections and wield political influence.” At the time, Rep. Lee reportedly did not take a clear stance. The Reform Party would need a fitting justification to merge with the People Power Party before the general election. (오 시장이 서울 시정에 매여 ‘여의도 정치’에 직접 개입하는 데에는 한계가 있는 만큼, 이 대표가 향후 야권 재편의 변수로 작용할 수 있다는 시각이다. 실제 옛 친윤계 핵심 인사는 지난 지방선거를 며칠 앞둔 시점에 이 대표와 단둘이 만나 “선거 이후 국민의힘으로 돌아와서 정치력을 발휘해달라”는 취지로 설득한 것으로 전해졌다. 당시 이 대표는 별다른 입장을 밝히지 않았다고 한다. 개혁신당은 총선 전 국민의힘과 합당하려면 그에 걸맞은 명분이 필요한 상황이다.)

An opposition insider said, “We’re currently in a unique situation where ‘Oh, Han, and Seok’—mentioned as conservative presidential candidates—cannot actively operate within the People Power Party. Depending on which of these three the pro-Yoon faction, which holds the largest number within the party, chooses as its next standard-bearer, the opposition’s landscape could fluctuate.” (야권 관계자는 “지금은 보수 진영의 대선 주자로 거론되는 ‘오·한·석(오세훈·한동훈·이준석)’이 국민의힘이라는 정당 내부에서 본격적으로 활동하지 못하는 독특한 상황”이라면서 “당내에서 가장 많은 수를 차지하는 친윤계가 세 사람 중 누구를 차기로 선택하느냐에 따라 야권 지형도 출렁일 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Military Claims "Allegations of Minister Ahn's Desertion Are False," But Says It Will Correct Service Record After His Term Ends (“安장관 탈영 의혹 허위”라면서, 복무 기간 기록은 퇴임 후 고치겠다는 軍)
item.description:
Regarding the allegations that Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek deserted his post during his service as a reserve soldier, the Ministry of National Defense stated on the 10th, "This is clearly false," adding, "We will request a correction of the error in the military service record after the minister's term ends." However, the ministry made it clear that it will neither disclose the military service record nor file a correction request during his tenure. (안규백 국방부 장관이 방위병 복무 시절 군무 이탈을 했다는 의혹과 관련해 국방부는 10일 “명백한 허위”라며 “장관 임기가 끝나면 병적기록 오류에 대해 정정을 청구하겠다”고 밝혔다. 하지만 병적기록을 공개하거나, 임기 중에 병적기록 정정 청구를 하지는 않겠다는 입장을 분명히 했다.)

It is known that Minister Ahn’s service period is recorded as 22 months in the military service record, rather than the usual 14 months, and this issue was raised by the opposition during his confirmation hearing in July of last year. The controversy reignited when Kim Young-soo, head of the Public Interest Reporting Center for a Clean Society, claimed at a National Assembly press conference on the 6th that Minister Ahn had been absent from duty for approximately seven months during his service, resulting in 30 days of confinement recorded as 'confinement 30 days' in his military record, and that he subsequently served an additional seven months. <<> In response, a Ministry of National Defense official told reporters, "According to the academic records from Sungkyunkwan University disclosed during the confirmation hearing, it is clear that he enlisted on November 5, 1983, and was discharged on January 4, 1985. If the claim that he deserted and served an additional seven months were true, I would ask how he could have university grades for the first semester of 1985." Regarding Minister Ahn’s refusal to disclose his military service record, the official said, "If we were to release a record with errors from 40 years ago, wouldn’t only the incorrect record stick in people’s minds, regardless of the facts? That’s why we haven’t disclosed it—to avoid further misunderstanding." When asked whether the military record includes a note of 'confinement 30 days,' the official replied, "It’s hard to say for certain." <<> Although Minister Ahn has maintained since 2016 that he discovered the 'error' in his military service record, he has never submitted a request to correct it to the Military Manpower Administration, neither during his tenure as the National Assembly Defense Committee chairman nor after becoming Defense Minister. A Ministry of National Defense official said, "If he were to request a correction while serving as minister, wouldn’t it spark further controversy? He plans to request a correction and take additional measures once he returns to a position without any power." This suggests that requesting a modification of the military record while in office could raise questions about impartiality. However, a military source commented, "The problem is that the current defense minister is under suspicion of desertion—what good would it do to file a correction after leaving office?" (안 장관의 복무 기간은 통상적인 14개월이 아닌 22개월로 병적기록부에 기록돼 있는 것으로 알려졌고, 지난해 7월 인사청문회에서도 야당의 문제 제기가 있었다. 이와 관련한 논란은 청렴사회를 위한 공익신고센터 김영수 센터장이 지난 6일 국회 기자회견에서 안 장관이 복무 중 약 7개월간 군무를 이탈했고, 이로 인해 약 30일간 구금돼 병적기록에 ‘구금 30일’이 있으며, 이후 7개월을 추가 복무했다고 주장하면서 다시 불거졌다.)

item.title: Lee: "Please Take Good Care of Mineral Cooperation"… Meets with All Top Three Officials in Mongolia (李 “광물 협력 잘 챙겨달라”… 몽골 서열 1·2·3위 모두 만나)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, attended a state banquet with President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh on the 10th (local time). President Lee also met with Chairman of the State Great Khural Sandag Byambatsogt and Prime Minister Nyam-Osor Oyuun-Erdene, meeting the top three officials in Mongolia. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 10일(현지 시각) 오흐나 후렐수흐 대통령과 국빈 만찬을 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 산닥 뱜바척트 국회의장, 냠오소르 오츠랄 총리도 접견하며 몽골 서열 1~3위를 모두 만났다.)

During the meeting with Prime Minister Oyuun-Erdene, President Lee stated, "I hope you will take good care of the various agendas we agreed upon yesterday (at the summit), especially economic exchange, critical mineral cooperation, and defense industry cooperation." At the subsequent banquet, about 40 South Korean business figures, including LS Group Chairman Koo Ja-eun, attended. The Office of the President stated, "We anticipate this will serve as an opportunity to strengthen economic cooperation between the two countries." (오츠랄 총리 접견에서 이 대통령은 “우리가 어제 (정상회담에서) 합의한 여러 가지 의제들, 특히 경제 교류, 핵심광물 협력, 방위 산업 분야 협력 등도 잘 챙겨 주시면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이후 열린 만찬에는 구자은 LS 회장 등 우리 경제인 40여 명도 참석했으며, 청와대는 “양국 경제 협력 강화로 이어질 수 있는 계기가 되기를 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee gifted President Khürelsükh a set of traditional Korean bows (Gukgung) made by combining materials such as buffalo horn and bamboo using traditional techniques. On the final day of the state visit, the 11th, President Lee and the first lady are scheduled to attend the "Naadam Festival," Mongolia's largest national event featuring archery, horse riding, and Bokh (Mongolian wrestling), as official guests of honor. (이 대통령은 후렐수흐 대통령에게 물소뿔, 대나무 등을 접합해서 전통 기법으로 제작한 국궁 세트 등을 선물했다. 이 대통령 부부는 국빈 방문 마지막 날인 11일 오전 활쏘기, 승마, 부흐(몽골식 씨름) 경기를 핵심으로 하는 몽골 최대 국가 행사 ‘나담 축제’에 공식 주빈으로 참석할 예정이다.)

Earlier that morning, President Lee visited the memorial park for independence activist Lee Tae-jun, who served as a royal physician to the Mongolian king and supported the independence movement, laying flowers at a symbolic grave. At a subsequent luncheon meeting with the South Korean community in Mongolia, President Lee remarked, "I've heard that in Ulaanbaatar, Korean-run shops, restaurants, cafes, academies, and businesses are clustered together, forming a vibrant Korean economic zone often called 'Montan' (a blend of Mongolia and Dongtan)." He added, "Mongolia's nomadic spirit and Korea's unique pioneering spirit serve as a significant link for mutual understanding." (앞서 이 대통령은 이날 오전 몽골 국왕의 어의(御醫)로 활동하며 독립운동을 지원했던 이태준 열사 기념 공원을 방문해 가묘에 헌화했다. 이어진 몽골 교민들과의 오찬 간담회에서 이 대통령은 “울란바타르에는 한국 상점과 식당, 카페, 학원, 기업이 밀집하면서 ‘몽탄(몽골과 동탄의 합성어) 신도시’라고 불릴 만큼 활기찬 한인 경제권이 형성됐다고 들었다”며 “(몽골의) 유목 정신과 한국 특유의 개척정신은 서로를 이해하는 큰 연결고리”라고 했다.)

item.title: "Supplementary Investigations Limited to Two Months Maximum Even Upon Prosecutor's Request"… Concerns Raised from First Review (“檢 요구로 보완수사해도 최대 2개월뿐”… 첫 심사부터 우려 목소리)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 10th held a standalone session of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's Subcommittee on Bill Review 1 to examine an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that strips prosecutors of their supplementary investigation authority, leaving only the power to request such investigations. The People Power Party, which has opposed the Democratic Party's unilateral formation of standing committees, boycotted the session. The Supreme Prosecutors' Office argued for maintaining the supplementary investigation authority, while the Ministry of Justice expressed concerns over potential side effects of its abolition. During the review process, there were also calls to reconsider the maximum two-month period for supplementary investigations specified in the Democratic Party's proposal. <<> Kim Seung-won, the ruling party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, met with reporters after the meeting and stated, "The content of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment is so vast and procedurally complex that today we proceeded by receiving a report from the committee's chief expert and jointly interpreting the bill's content and review opinions. Issues addressed included the removal of prosecutors' investigative authority, the unification of investigative powers, the relationship between prosecutors and judicial police officers, and whether prosecutors can direct investigations by special judicial police officers." The committee plans to hear opinions from various ministries in next week's meeting and begin detailed discussions on the bill's content. Regarding the timeline for handling the bill, Kim said, "We will conduct the bill review as swiftly and intensively as possible." The Democratic Party aims to pass the Criminal Procedure Act amendment before its national convention on the 17th of next month. <<> The Criminal Procedure Act amendment proposed by the Democratic Party requires judicial police officers who receive a request for supplementary investigation to complete it within one month, with a possible one-month extension. However, the committee's expert submitted a review opinion stating, "It is necessary to examine whether limiting the supplementary investigation period to a maximum of two months is appropriate for investigative practice." Legal circles also point out that setting the implementation period for supplementary investigation requests to within one month is unrealistic. <<> Yang Hong-seok, a lawyer who served as an advisor to the Prime Minister's Office's Prosecution Reform Promotion Committee, wrote on Facebook, "Even now, there are many cases where supplementary investigations are not completed within three months," adding, "If supplementary investigation requests must be fulfilled within one month, they will be carried out poorly. Due to insufficient investigation, prosecutors will have no choice but to drop charges, and even if indicted, the likelihood of acquittal will increase." This, he noted, would ultimately harm crime victims. <<> The Supreme Prosecutors' Office argued for maintaining prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority, citing reasons such as the organic connection between investigation and prosecution making functional separation difficult, and the need to hear directly from involved parties and collect additional evidence since investigative records alone are insufficient to grasp the truth. It added that specifying the scope of prosecutors' supplementary investigations by law could prevent indiscriminate investigations into unrelated cases. The Ministry of Justice expressed concern, stating, "Discussions on effective measures to mitigate the side effects of abolishing the supplementary investigation authority are necessary," and noted, "Cross-verification for unfairly treated parties would be impossible, and serious investigative delays such as 'case ping-pong' could occur." <<> The People Power Party opposes the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority, framing it as "complete police monopolization of investigative power." Choi Su-jin, the People Power Party's senior deputy spokesperson, said, "This is an act of leaving police power unchecked, fostering a second or third Jang Yun-gi case, and undermining the judicial system." She added, "There are growing criticisms that the amendment's 'one-month supplementary investigation' rule is unrealistic and will only lead to poor investigations, case shifting, and repeated delays." <<> Experts have also voiced concerns. The Advisory Committee of the Prosecution Reform Promotion Committee, established under the Prime Minister's Office to discuss the direction of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment but later dissolved after committee members resigned collectively due to disagreements with the government and ruling party, issued a statement in June stating, "The goal of reforming the criminal justice system must be to protect citizens' rights and achieve criminal justice," and maintained that "prosecutors' supplementary investigations are necessary, even if limited." (더불어민주당은 10일 국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사1소위를 단독으로 열어 검찰 보완수사권을 박탈하고 보완수사 요구권만 남기는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 심사했다. 민주당의 일방적 상임위 구성에 반발해온 국민의힘은 불참했다. 대검찰청은 보완수사권 유지를 주장했고, 법무부는 폐지에 따른 부작용을 우려했다. 심사 과정에선 민주당안에서 최대 2개월로 명시된 보완수사 기간의 검토가 필요하다는 지적도 나왔다.)

item.title: "Why Son Heung-min?" Backlash Forces Ruling Party to Withdraw Hearing Witness (“손흥민을 왜” 역풍에… 與, 청문회 참고인 철회)
item.description:
Some lawmakers from the ruling party have withdrawn their proposals after facing public criticism, including an attempt to summon a national football team player to a parliamentary hearing and a bill that would allow companies to pay workers in local currencies. (여당 일부 의원이 국회 청문회에 축구 국가대표 선수를 부르려 하거나, 기업이 노동자에게 지역 화폐로 임금을 줄 수 있게 하는 법안을 추진하다가 비판 여론이 일자 철회했다.)

Rep. Lim Oh-kyung of the Democratic Party of Korea requested on the 9th that football players Son Heung-min (LA FC) and Hwang Hee-chan (Wolverhampton Wanderers) be summoned as witnesses to a parliamentary hearing on the Korea Football Association scheduled for the 22nd, held by the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee. This drew criticism as being unrealistic, given that Son and other players had a match with their team in the United States the following day. On the 10th, Rep. Lim posted on Facebook, stating, "I applied to summon these witnesses to hear the voices of players with firsthand experience in the association, the national team, and overseas football systems." She added, "I have withdrawn my request after comprehensively considering the party's views, the players' schedules, and their positions." (더불어민주당 임오경 의원은 지난 9일 국회 문화체육관광위원회에 손흥민(LA FC)·황희찬(울버햄프턴) 선수를 22일 열리는 대한축구협회 청문회에 참고인으로 불러 달라고 요청했다. 이를 두고 다음 날 미국에서 소속팀 경기가 있는 손 선수 등을 부르는 것은 비현실적이라는 비판이 일었다. 임 의원은 10일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “협회와 국가대표팀, 해외 축구 시스템을 가까이서 경험한 선수들의 목소리를 듣고자 참고인을 신청한 것”이라며 “당의 의견과 선수들의 경기 일정, 입장을 종합적으로 고려해 신청을 철회했다”고 밝혔다.)

Rep. Park Min-gyu of the Democratic Party, citing benefits for revitalizing local economies, proposed a revision to the Labor Standards Act on the 7th that would allow employers to pay workers in "local currencies" instead of cash, provided the employee gives explicit consent. The Korean Federation of Trade Unions objected, stating, "Workers' wages are not a tool for policy purposes," while the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions argued, "Workers at small businesses with weak bargaining power and non-regular workers are highly likely to be targeted." Rep. Park withdrew the bill on the 10th. (민주당 박민규 의원은 지역 경제 활성화에 도움이 될 것이라며 지난 7일 근로자의 명시적 동의가 있는 경우, 사용자가 근로자에게 임금을 돈이 아닌 ‘지역 화폐’로 줄 수 있게 하는 내용의 근로기준법 개정안을 발의했다. 한국노총은 “노동자의 임금은 정책 목적을 위한 수단이 아니다”라고 했고, 민주노총도 “협상력이 약한 중소 사업장과 비정규직 노동자가 대상이 될 가능성이 높다”고 반발했다. 박 의원은 10일 법안 발의를 철회했다.)
